metadata.title: Why do East Asian students do so well in mathematics? A machine learning study

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study used multiple plausible values and applied Rubin's rules for handling them.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study uses ILSA student-level data but does not mention whether sampling weights were applied.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study used a single-level random forest regression model, ignoring the hierarchical structure of the data.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study performed internal validation using tenfold cross-validation with five repeats, indicating no validation on external data.
